name: start_vela_login
description: Start OpenDesign Cloud browser sign-in through the local OpenDesign daemon. Returns the activation URL and user code when manual browser completion is needed. The tool name is an internal compatibility identifier and must not be repeated to the user.

pluginWorkflowId.description: Opaque workflow id issued by the local OpenDesign MCP after the first attributed call. Reuse it for later plugin-attributed calls; never invent or display it.
